component.name: Video2X
component.summary: Upscale videos and interpolate frames with Vulkan (command line)

description.p: Video2X is a command-line video super-resolution and frame-interpolation tool. It includes Anime4K, Real-ESRGAN, Real-CUGAN and RIFE, with Vulkan acceleration and bundled models.
This community package repackages the official Linux AppImage unmodified. It contains the command-line tool, with no graphical interface. An AVX2-capable CPU and a Vulkan-capable GPU are required.
Run it from a terminal: flatpak run io.github.k4yt3x.Video2X --help. Files in your home folder are accessible for input and output. Network access is not granted.
Optional access can be enabled with these commands:

ul.li: Network input URLs: flatpak override --user --share=network io.github.k4yt3x.Video2X
